system.description:
Secret (a forge beneath the Giant's Fist). Study: a Master of Weaponsmithing or Armourer, working with a caster who has 7th-level spells (one character may be both); 4 weeks at the forge, DC 15.

Teaches: making one Unique, the only way one is made: choose its power from the Power table or design one with the GM, and roll its quirk.

The work: 2,500 gp for +1, 5,000 gp for +2, 10,000 gp for +3 (5,000 gp with no bonus), 1 week per 500 gp, a Special Material tied to its power, and the caster's check, DC 20.

  • The forge takes one commission from each smith, ever.
  • The giant-smiths' anvil where Wyrmsbane was made.
  • It lies cold beneath the Giant's Fist.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
